mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE (audited_at > #{cursor.auditedAt} OR (audited_at = #{cursor.auditedAt} AND id > #{cursor.id})) ORDER BY audited_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) sub ORDER BY audited_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (user_id, audited_at, action, entity_type, entity_id, detail) VALUES (#{userId}, #{auditedAt}, #{action}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{detail,typeHandler=com.example.jsppractice.mapper.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler})
